title: PermissionRuleEvaluation
description: `POST /permission-rules/evaluate`: testing a command without running it — the same precedence a live session uses, over the caller's own rules (plan 15, B-14). No effect of any kind: nothing is stored, no event, no push.

answeringRule.description: The rule that answers, `null` when no rule does — the mode may still answer (see `reasons`).

matching.description: Every rule that matched, the one that answered included — what explains "why my allow did not win".

caveats.description: What the engine decides before any rule of ours is even asked (plan 15, D-12) — declared by the engine's adapter, never guessed here.
